dataset_title: Abstract-level pilot observations for PEF-assisted grass-clover pressing and protein separation
license: The accessible article landing page identifies the work as open access; a secondary author-profile record lists CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. This extract is limited to attributed abstract-level factual observations; verify the authoritative article license before redistributing full text, figures, or supplementary material.
geography: Pilot facility study; institution and full experimental geography should be verified from the full article before applying geographically.
experimental_context: Fresh blend of perennial ryegrass (70%) and white clover (30%); large-scale screw pressing combined with industrial-scale pulsed-electric-field pretreatment. A disk separator processed 400 L of raw juice after protein precipitation at pH 5.0 and 60 °C.
data_handling: Eight reported abstract facts/values transcribed as printed; relative increases retain the untreated-control comparator and approximate qualifier. No conversion, inferred absolute yield, or interpolation was performed.
applicability: Phase 3–4 comparator for pressing, PEF response, juice processing scale, precipitation pH/temperature, and crude-protein product composition. Not a GreenHub roadside-grass calibration dataset.
limitations: Only the abstract was used; methods, replicate counts, uncertainty, absolute mass yields, machine settings, process duration, PEF energy, chemical consumption, and complete component balances are not represented.
The feed is a cultivated grass-clover blend rather than Dutch roadside grass.
Approximately 25% higher juice yield and 31% higher crude-protein yield are comparative increases, not absolute recovery fractions and not transferable default multipliers.
The reported 37.3 g crude protein per 100 g DM is product concentration, not protein yield or true-protein purity.

Only precipitation pH and temperature are opt-in runtime candidates. The other six abstract facts remain reference-only; relative PEF yield gains, product concentration, and processed juice volume are not activated as model inputs.
The abstract does not provide a titration curve, acid/base mass, precipitation recovery, residence time, or heat duty; verify the authoritative article license before broader redistribution.
